chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu al-Jarud Ziyad ibn al-Mundhir al-Abdi, said:

I heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) saying: 'Fast when the people fast, and break your fast when the people break their fast, for indeed Allah, Exalted and Glorious, made the crescents (of the months) as fixed times (for worship).'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on following the community for fasting times according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) emphasizes the principle of *ittiba'* (following the majority) in determining the start and end of Ramadan, ensuring communal unity in worship. This hadith, found in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores that while individual sighting is valid, adhering to the community's established calendar based on the lunar crescents (*ahillah*) prevents division and aligns with the Quranic designation of these markers as divine timekeepers.
